evidence.title: Welcome to Gestalt - Pinterest's Design System

name: Gestalt (Pinterest's Design System)
summary: Pinterest's design system: foundations and React UI components; the iOS overview page sits behind an Okta login.
description: Guidelines on color palettes, typography and iconography plus a library of ready-to-use React components for building Pinterest's product experiences (Accordion, ActivationCard, Avatar, Badge, Banner, Button, Checkbox, Chart and more). The catalogued /ios/overview page redirects to Pinterest's Okta sign-in; the site root and the versioned v1 docs (flagged as legacy, pointing to 'Gestalt 2.0') are public.
contains: foundations: color palettes, typography, iconography, design principles
React components for web: Accordion, Avatar, Badge, Banner, Button, Checkbox, Chart and more
the /ios/overview page redirects to an Okta sign-in (login required)
v1 docs are flagged as legacy ('Explore Gestalt 2.0')
